security_spec.violation_condition: The kernel enables stvec.MODE=11 (Smivt interrupt vector table mode) causing scause to encode external interrupts with major identity in bits 15:0 and minor identity in bits XLEN-2:16, while kernel code at entry.S:225, entry.S:218, traps.c:96, traps.c:135, signal.c:504, mm/fault.c:288, and KVM vcpu_exit.c:193-237 continues to interpret scause via direct equality comparisons against EXC_* constants or via raw bitwise operations (CAUSE_IRQ_FLAG, slli-indexed vector table), expecting the standard flat exception-code encoding.
security_spec.summary: Smivt mode=11 repacks external-interrupt scause as {minor[XLEN-2:16], major[15:0]}, breaking every kernel site that compares scause against EXC_* constants or indexes exception vector tables by raw scause value
